action.sql: WITH ar AS (SELECT SUM(amount - amount_paid) AS ar_outstanding FROM ar_invoices WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND invoice_date <= DATE '2026-06-30'), rev AS (SELECT SUM(g.credit - g.debit) AS q2_revenue FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = g.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'CA01' AND a.type = 'Revenue' AND g.period IN ('2026-04', '2026-05', '2026-06')) SELECT ar.ar_outstanding, rev.q2_revenue, ar.ar_outstanding / rev.q2_revenue * 91 AS dso_days FROM ar, rev
